about: The categories' development set (branch carnet-categories, 22/11): pages a person of any age might keep, written for this work without seeing the blind set (briefs/carnet-blind-set-1122.*, never opened), each a new subject page: its title and its first line (its « En bref »), and where the person would look first (`expected`: the first counts; a second where they could look too). `trap`: a word of the page points elsewhere (« cadeau » on a colleague's leaving drinks, « location » for a holiday rental, « week-end » on a work rota…). Conventions: a bill or a contract is Papiers (Argent second), taxes Argent (Papiers second), rent and the building Maison, a car's insurance and registration Papiers, school forms Papiers, the children's school evenings Personnes, a doctor's papers Papiers, hobbies, books, series, sport and learning Autres. Tuned on, with the demo: the fresh blind set is the measure. Played by bridge-rs categories.rs `the_dev_set_is_filed_where_a_person_looks` (floor) and `dev_set_report` (ignored: the misses).
